correctness.rationale: The bijection x0=0 <-> length-n even-parity cyclic edge differences is one-to-one; pin suppresses precisely the flip at site zero. The derived open-boundary wall update erodes each maximal 1-run by two until length 0 or 1, yielding exact tau. Unique decomposition into initial 1-run followed by (0,1-run) factors gives G_L=S_L/(1-zS_L). Even parity projection provides all A_n(t). No surviving odd run iff every original run even; the resulting generating series is 1/(1-z-z^2), proving F_(n+1) all-zero basin. The final-layer classification is all walls 1 for even n, or the two length-(n-1) end runs for odd n. Both reproducible standalone programs passed on real package paths and independently check the direct majority process and the integer coefficients. Infinite proof does not depend on finite tests.

value.rationale: A single immutable opinion is a natural minimal control intervention in one-dimensional majority dynamics. The all-zero basin probability F_(n+1)/2^(n-1), exponentially decaying even though every trajectory freezes, quantifies the precise reliability of that intervention; the rational A_n(t) family simultaneously gives complete stabilization-time tails at all sizes. These precise statistics are not simply fixed-state counts or maximal transient times, both already in Inokuchi-Sato. They are natural exact model invariants with plausible use for opinion/control outcomes; no broad general theorem or application is assumed.
